instructions.right_eye: OD (right eye): occlude OS completely. Read the smallest row you can, left to right, without guessing.
instructions.left_eye: OS (left eye): occlude OD completely. Same task — smallest clear row, left to right.
instructions.initial_helper: Record at least 4 of 5 letters correctly on this row to move to a smaller (harder) row — as in threshold acuity testing.
instructions.retry_helper: Same row size — new letters. Take your time; call each letter clearly.
instructions.switch_eye_helper: Cover the fellow eye fully before starting the next eye.
instructions.near_phase: Near vision, both eyes at your usual reading distance: choose the smallest print that remains comfortable.
instructions.astig_phase: Radial pattern: with both eyes, do all spokes look equally sharp, or are some darker or smeared?
instructions.astig_helper: Subjective screening only — not a diagnosis of astigmatism or any other condition.
instructions.contrast_phase: Which side shows the letter with better contrast and clarity?
